title: Carrot Halva Custard Ice Cream
changes_from_base: Carrot, ginger, tahini and warm spices cooked into the base and blended, with brown sugar and pistachios; no vanilla.
summary: Inspired by carrot halva, this version of our classic custard simmers grated carrot, ginger, tahini and warm spices in the dairy and blends them in, then adds toasted pistachios. Sweet, spiced and nutty.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
shelled pistachios, toasted and roughly chopped

steps.title: Simmer the flavourings
steps.text: Combine the cream, milk, carrot, ginger, tahini, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves and nutmeg in the saucepan and keep at a bare simmer for 15-20 min, stirring now and then, until the carrot is soft. Remove the cloves and cardamom pods and add the salt.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: In the heatproof bowl, beat the yolks with the brown sugar until smooth and a little paler.

steps.title: Temper
steps.text: Ladle in two or three spoonfuls of the hot spiced base, whisking, until the bowl feels warm, then return everything to the pan.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Keep stirring over low heat for about 5 min, to 77-80 °C, until a line drawn on the spatula holds.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the hot base for about 2 min until velvety, venting the lid and covering it with a towel.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Pour into a bowl, cool over the iced water and refrigerate for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn until thick and add the pistachios in the last minute. Serve soft, or freeze for 2 h for firmer scoops.

tips: Grate the carrot on the fine side of the grater so it softens quickly.
A common mistake is skipping the blending, which leaves stringy carrot. Blend until completely smooth.
Stir the tahini jar well before measuring, as the oil separates.
storage: Freeze in a covered container for up to 2 weeks.
